name: refactor_js_prototype_to_class
description: Constructor-function + prototype methods -> ES class, behavior-preserving; drift broken loses the static on the factory method
prompts: wallet.js implements Wallet the pre-ES2015 way: a constructor function, methods assigned to Wallet.prototype, and a factory attached directly to the constructor (Wallet.fromCents). Refactor it to an ES class: constructor, instance methods deposit/withdraw/balance, and fromCents as a STATIC method - with no `prototype` assignments left in the file. This is a pure refactor: the module still exports { Wallet }, deposit/withdraw still validate and chain (return this) with the exact same RangeError messages, balance() still returns the same fixed-2 string, and Wallet.fromCents(owner, cents) must still be callable on the constructor itself and return a Wallet instance.
